control.transport: HTTPS with mutual TLS; dedicated self-signed control CA and exact API client certificate pin

create.agentId: UUID from installation; never inferred from Windows hostname
create.repeaterId: string of 1-9 decimal digits; no leading zero
create.certificateSha256: exact device certificate SHA256; lowercase 64 hex; must match gateway binding
create.expiresAt: absolute RFC3339 timestamp; at most 900 seconds in future for a new lease
create.idempotency: same sessionId and canonical body returns original state; never renews or reopens; different body returns 409

get.credential: password only for existing open lease, only internal mTLS API; no-store

states.ready: device mTLS certificate plus 250-byte Mode II ID accepted
states.connected: one private viewer TCP connection; does not prove VNC login or desktop rendering
states.closed: streams destroyed and new peers rejected

viewer.authorization: same mTLS CA and exact API client certificate pin; only ready lease; one viewer
viewer.ticket: 32 random bytes, base64url; SHA256 only retained; one use; at most 30 seconds
viewer.viewerUrl: fixed configured public HTTPS origin + /pdv-remote/open; no query or fragment
viewer.expiresAt: exact original lease deadline, never extended

enrollment.authorization: same internal mTLS CA and exact API client certificate pin; backend authorizes installation/admin activation; never reachable on device port
enrollment.csr: one public CSR <=4096 bytes; proof of private-key possession; CN=pdv-<agentId>; no requested extensions copied
enrollment.certificatePem: leaf plus one device-root-signed intermediate; no private key or VNC password
enrollment.idempotency: stable requestId and exact body; persists restart; conflicting/superseded generation 409
enrollment.issuer: opt-in server-local intermediate key only; root CA private key stays offline
enrollment.validityDays: 1..90; default90; renewal requires current fingerprint and no active lease

deviceRevoke.behavior: durable tombstone; closes active leases; removes accepted fingerprint; repeat idempotent; unknown device404; no automatic re-enrollment

device.transport: TLS 1.2+ mutual authentication; distinct self-signed device CA; exact certificate-agent-ID binding
device.modeII: 250-byte ASCII ID:<repeaterId> padded with NUL; opaque RFB afterward
device.consent: backend must receive valid local operator decision before creating any lease

isolation.viewer: private TCP listener; only guacd IP allowlist; no publicly published VNC ports
isolation.ports: never reused automatically, including restart; usedPorts durable journal persists beyond closed-session retention; capacity fails closed
isolation.expiry: gateway own timer destroys both streams; JSON authentication expiry is not session timeout
isolation.restart: no resume; all open leases become closed; stale lock requires operator review
isolation.secrets: no VNC password, key, nonce, screen or keyboard data in journal
isolation.enrollmentState: separate private enrollment journal contains VNC device passwords and durable bindings; no client private keys; atomic fsync and single-writer lock; failure closes leases

open.response: 200 document on viewer origin; script then navigates to session URL, preserving Strict cookie behavior

browser.cookie: __Secure-pdv_remote; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; path exclusive to session; random credential; never available to JavaScript

state.output: state, absolute expiry and CSRF; no Guacamole credentials

end.response: closed only after gateway close; clears cookie

browser.tunnel: Guacamole HTTP tunnel proxy; cookie + CSRF + independent browser token; no query authToken; fixed internal upstream
browser.secrets: VNC password, JSON key, Guacamole authToken and internal tunnel token stay server-side; no query/fragment/storage credentials
browser.timeouts: lease absolute timer plus 20-second inactivity reaper; no automatic reconnect
browser.closedConfirmation: 60-second bounded tombstone grants only end confirmation with same cookie/CSRF; never reconnects
browser.caveat: transport connected does not prove VNC authentication or rendered desktop

agentApi.consent: authenticated POST /api/pdv-monitor/agent/remote/consent; local operator decision required
agentApi.lease: authenticated GET /api/pdv-monitor/agent/remote/lease; closed XML root PdvRemoteLease schemaVersion=1
agentApi.heartbeat: only a new authenticated valid lease response renews native authorization; at most 15 seconds without confirmation
agentApi.status: authenticated POST /api/pdv-monitor/agent/remote/status; local process shutdown must be proven before closed
